# Play — Good Fences

- SudokuPad: [Good Fences on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Good Fences on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed) including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
White dots are exported as native f-puzzles difference dots. Renban lines are exported as pink lines, because f-puzzles has
no native renban. The negative constraint is set with f-puzzles' top-level `nonconsecutive` flag (corrected in run 7: until then the
links used `negative: ["difference"]`, which is not an f-puzzles field, so apps silently dropped the negative constraint).
Not every app may enforce the flag, so the rules text is the authority. SudokuPad checks your answer against the embedded solution either way.
Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (givens, constraints, solution).
